results.answer:
내년 봄(2027년 3~5월)에 열리는 해외 하프마라톤 5개를 찾았어요. 유럽 대회가 주를 이루며, 모두 3월에 집중되어 있습니다.

## 추천 대회 비교표

| 대회명 | 날짜 | 종목 | 접수 마감일 | 코스 특성 | 인천 출발 항공권 | 대회장 근처 숙소 | 출처 |
|--------|------|------|------------|-----------|----------------|----------------|------|
| **바르셀로나 하프마라톤** (Barcelona Half Marathon) | 2027년 2월 14일 (요청 기간 밖) (일) | 하프 | 2026년 5월 접수 마감 (매진) | 평탄하고 빠른 코스. 남자 세계기록(56:42) 보유. 해안가 바람 주의 | 약 138만원 (목업) | 1박 18~30만원 (목업) | [공식 사이트](https://mediasmaratonesespana.eu.com/event/half-marathon-barcelona/) |
| **리스본 하프마라톤** (EDP Lisbon Half Marathon) | 2027년 3월 7일 (일) | 하프 | 확인 불가 (대기자 명단 운영 중) | 완만한 기복(고저차 185m). SuperHalfs 시리즈. 빠른 기록 가능 | 약 139만원 (목업) | 1박 10~22만원 (목업) | [공식 사이트](https://marathonscout.com/races/edp-lisbon-half-marathon) |
| **파리 하프마라톤** (HOKA Semi de Paris) | 2027년 3월 7일 (일) | 하프 | 2026년 9월 30일 추첨 마감 | 평탄한 코스(고저차 45m). 기록 잘 나옴 | 약 154만원 (목업) | 1박 13~28만원 (목업) | [공식 사이트](https://en.run-motion.com/paris-half-marathon-2027-registration/) |
| **로마 하프마라톤** (Run Rome The Marathon 하프 종목) | 2027년 3월 14일 (일) | 하프 | 접수 진행 중 | 완만한 기복(고저차 97m). 관광 명소 통과 | 약 144만원 (목업) | 1박 10~25만원 (목업) | [공식 사이트](https://marathonscout.com/races/run-rome-the-marathon) |
| **예루살렘 마라톤** (Jerusalem Winner Marathon 하프 종목) | 2027년 3월 19일 (금) | 하프 | 접수 진행 중 | 언덕 많음(고저차 556m). 기록보다 완주 중심 | 약 143만원 (목업) | 1박 12~30만원 (목업) | [공식 사이트](https://marathonscout.com/races/jerusalem-marathon) |

## 대회별 상세 정보

### 1. 바르셀로나 하프마라톤 (2월 14일)
- **코스**: 완전 평탄. 2025년 남자 세계기록(56:42) 수립. 해안가 구간에서 바람 영향 있음
- **특징**: 스페인 최대 하프마라톤. 4만 명 규모. 접수 개시 1주일 만에 매진
- **접수**: 2026년 5월 매진. 공식 마켓플레이스에서 양도 가능 (1월 30일까지)
- **참가비**: €36~50 (접수 순서에 따라 차등)

### 2. 리스본 하프마라톤 (3월 7일)
- **코스**: 25 de Abril 다리에서 출발, 강변 따라 달리는 코스. 고저차 185m로 완만한 기복
- **특징**: SuperHalfs 시리즈. 세계에서 가장 빠른 하프마라톤 중 하나. 2026년 세계기록(57:20) 수립
- **접수**: 대기자 명단 운영 중
- **제한시간**: 3시간

### 3. 파리 하프마라톤 (3월 7일)
- **코스**: 평탄(고저차 45m). 2027년 코스는 2027년 초 공개 예정
- **특징**: 5만 명 규모. 2027년부터 새 주최사(Cadence Running United)로 변경
- **접수**: 2026년 9월 30일 추첨 마감. 당첨자는 72시간 내 결제
- **참가비**: €79 (단일 가격)

### 4. 로마 하프마라톤 (3월 14일)
- **코스**: Fori Imperiali 출발, 콜로세움·산피에트로 등 명소 통과. 고저차 97m
- **특징**: Run Rome The Marathon 대회의 하프 종목. 보스턴 마라톤 예선 대회
- **접수**: 진행 중
- **제한시간**: 확인 불가

### 5. 예루살렘 마라톤 (3월 19일)
- **코스**: 언덕이 많은 코스(고저차 556m). 구시가지와 현대 예루살렘 통과
- **특징**: 금요일 개최. 반복되는 오르막으로 기록보다 완주에 집중
- **접수**: 진행 중
- **제한시간**: 확인 불가

## 참고사항
- **항공권·숙소 가격**: 목업(실제 가격 아님). 실제 예약 시 가격이 다를 수 있습니다.
- **접수 마감일**: 공식 사이트에서 반드시 재확인하세요.
- **기록 추천**: 바르셀로나(평탄), 파리(평탄), 리스본(빠른 코스) 순으로 기록이 잘 나옵니다.
- **관광 추천**: 로마, 예루살렘은 관광 명소가 많아 여행과 병행하기 좋습니다.

**주의**: 군산 새만금 국제마라톤(4월 4일)은 한국 대회이므로 해외 대회 목록에서 제외했습니다.

{"url": "https://mediasmaratonesespana.eu.com/event/half-marathon-barcelona/", "content": "Barcelona Half Marathon 2027 – 14 February
Skip to content
Sunday 14 February 2027, 8:30, Passeig de Picasso
Men’s world record set here: 56:42 (2025)
40,000 bibs, sold out within a week
Women’s course record 1:04:01 (2026)
The Barcelona Half Marathon is 
Spain’s biggest half
 and the home of the 
men’s world record
: in February 2025 
Jacob Kiplimo ran 56:42
 here, a world record. The 2026 race on 15 February drew a record 
36,000 runners
: around 40% women and 40% from abroad, from 93 countries. Hagos Gebrhiwet won in 
58:05
, and Loice Chemnung set a women’s course record of 
1:04:01
. For 2027, capacity grows to 
40,000
, and every bib sold within a week of entries opening in May 2026.
The race has been held since 1991 and has been a World Athletics Gold Label road race since 2018. Its official name is now the Hyundai Mitja Marató Barcelona by Brooks.
The course
It’s a single loop that starts and finishes on 
Passeig de Picasso
, beside Parc de la Ciutadella. The organisers describe it as fully urban, running through the heart of the city and along its coast. In 2026 the route passed 
Sagrada Família
, 
Plaça de Catalunya
, 
Plaça d’Espanya
, the 
Columbus monument
 and the 
Arc de Triomf
, and the last kilometres ran beside the sea. Check the official map for 2027 in case of changes.
The course is flat, so hills aren’t the problem. 
Wind
 is. Gebrhiwet said the wind in the final stretch cost him a sub-58 in 2026. If the forecast is breezy, stay in a group along the seafront and save something for the last few kilometres.
Corrals
Runners start in 
colour-coded corrals
 and can only enter the corral that matches their bib. You can drop back to a slower corral whenever you like, but moving forward needs approval: email the organisers well before race week. The sub-elite corral needs proof of a result from the last two years: under 30:00 for 10K, 1:05 for the half or 2:15 for the marathon for men, and under 35:00, 1:15 or 2:35 for women.
If you have a bib
Collect it early if you care about your T-shirt size.
 Shirts are handed out in order of arrival while each size lasts, and sizes aren’t guaranteed. Thursday afternoon is your best chance.
Headphones
 aren’t banned, but the organisers ask you not to wear them so you can hear safety instructions. Elite runners can’t use them under federation rules.
Medal engraving
 is available straight after the finish, or you can order it later from the website.
There’s an 
official app
 so friends and family can follow you live.
If you don’t
The 2027 race sold out through normal entry, so the only realistic option is the organisers’ official 
Marketplace
, where runners who can’t start pass on their places. Transfers close at the end of January, so don’t leave it until race week.

FAQ
Frequently asked questions: Barcelona Half Marathon
When is the Barcelona Half Marathon 2027?
Sunday 14 February 2027. The main race starts at 8:30 and wheelchair athletes set off at 8:25.
Can I still enter the Barcelona Half Marathon 2027?
Not through normal entry: all 40,000 bibs sold out within a week of opening in May 2026. Look at the official Marketplace, where runners who can’t race pass on their places. A €16.95 management fee applies to transfers, and none are allowed after 30 January 2027.
How much did entry cost?
€36 for bibs 1 to 1,000, €40 for bibs 1,001 to 10,000 and €50 for bibs 10,001 to 40,000. You must be 18 or older on race day.
Are there pacers?
Yes, 30 of them, covering every five minutes from 1:20 to 2:05. They carry banners and start from the corral that matches their target time.
What is the time limit?
2 h 45 min, counted from when the last runner crosses the start line. Drinks (water and Aquarius) are at about km 5, 10, 15 and 17.5, with gels at km 15.
Can I collect my bib on race day?
No. Bibs are only handed out at Expo Sports from Thursday 11 to Saturday 13 February. A friend can collect yours with your confirmation (showing the bib number) and your ID. The timing chip is single use but must be returned after the finish, or you pay a €5 penalty.

enter a ballot

the whole team gets a race bib
.

How much does a Paris Half Marathon 2027 race bib cost?
The general public price for the HOKA Semi de Paris 2027 is 
€79
.
Unlike previous editions, there is a single price: it does not depend on when you enter the ballot.
Holders of a 
2026-2027 FFA (French Athletics Federation) licence
 can benefit from a 5% discount.
You only pay if you are drawn and confirm your registration.
What is the €25 Passerelle race bib?
For the 2027 edition, 
Passerelle race bibs at €25
 are available, subject to eligibility criteria and while stocks last.
This scheme offers race bibs at a reduced price to certain groups of people.
The exact eligibility conditions can be found directly with the organiser.
What is a Dossard Engagé (charity race bib)?
The 
Dossard Engagé
, or charity race bib, lets you take part in the Paris Half Marathon while supporting a partner charity.
It works differently from the ballot: you choose a charity, launch a fundraising campaign, and your race bib is allocated once the fundraising target has been reached.
Charity race bibs are therefore another way to get a race bib while supporting a cause.

official 2027 Paris Half Marathon course has not yet been revealed

How many runners take part in the Paris Half Marathon?
The Paris Half Marathon brings together tens of thousands of runners every year.
The 2026 edition had around 
50,000 participants
, making it one of the largest half marathons in France.
This high level of participation explains the strong demand for registration and race bibs.
Why is the Paris Half Marathon changing organiser?
From 2027, 
Amaury Sport Organisation (ASO)
 will no longer organise the Paris Half Marathon.
The City of Paris has awarded the contract to organise the Paris Marathon and Paris Half Marathon for the

This change of organiser brings several changes to how the event works, particularly regarding registration.

HOKA Semi de Paris

.

ballot

Charity race bibs

A course yet to be revealed

 The EDP Lisbon Half Marathon is a point-to-point road race held on a Sunday in March, starting on the 25 de Abril Bridge and finishing in front of the Jerónimos Monastery in Belém. It is organised by the Maratona Clube de Portugal, which staged the first edition in 1991. The mass field starts on the bridge deck and runs north into Lisbon, then follows the riverside west to a turnaround at Cruz Quebrada before heading back to the finish on the Praça do Império, by the monastery and the Centro Cultural de Belém. Elite runners start separately at Cruz Quebrada. A Vodafone 10k, a Hyundai 7k and a family walk run on the same morning, and a shorter EDP New Generation race for young runners takes place the day before. The half marathon has a participant limit of 20,000 and a three-hour time limit, and runners must be at least 18. Entry for the 2027 edition is through a ballot rather than first-come registration. The course has produced record times: Jacob Kiplimo ran 57:20 here in 2026, a half marathon world record at the time, and Tsigie Gebreselama holds the women's course record of 1:04:21 from 2025. The organisers describe it as one of the fastest half marathons in the world.

About the race
Race Description
The Rome Half Marathon is the Eternal City's autumn half, a single loop that packs in more ancient and Renaissance landmarks than almost any race in the world. It is a separate event from the spring Rome Marathon and the Roma-Ostia half, and has grown into a major international race.
The course starts at the Circus Maximus and heads south past the Pyramid of Cestius to the Basilica of St Paul Outside the Walls, before turning back into the historic centre. From there it winds past Piazza Venezia, Piazza Navona, Piazza del Popolo and the Spanish Steps on its way to a finish at the foot of the Colosseum.
With under 100 metres of climbing, the route is gentler than Rome's cobbles and hills might suggest. A non-competitive 5 km and a three-person relay that raises money for charity run alongside the half marathon.

 Competition Rules 
The race will be conducted in accordance with the latest rules and regulations of the WA, the JAAF, and this event.
Because the Osaka Marathon is a Label Road Race certified by the WA, the WA Road Race Label Regulations also apply. Doping control tests will be conducted in accordance with WA Rules.
 Line-up at Start 
To relieve congestion and ensure runner safety, a wave (time difference) start will be conducted.
Starting blocks will be determined by the organizer based on the self-reported personal best time and estimated finish time submitted at the time of application, regardless of whether the runner is registered with the Japan Association of Athletics Federations (JAAF). These decisions are made from the perspective of race management and safety.
Please note that starting from a block ahead of your assigned wave, you will be disqualified. Please make sure to start from your designated block.
 The personal best time must be from an official marathon event held on or after August 1, 2024, and must be either the gross time or net time. If false information is submitted, your entry may be disqualified. 
 The estimated finish time should be carefully calculated based on your half marathon results or regular training performance. 
 Group entries will start from the same block as the participant in the same group with the slowest personal best time and estimated time at application. 
 720〈Naniwa〉Marathon (Runners) shall start from Wave 3.

JAAF members are prohibited from participating in the race dressed in costume. Costume-clad runners are not allowed to start from Block A regardless of having JAAF membership or not.

가와라마치역에서 570m 거리에 있는 가모가와 공원(鴨川公園)을 중심으로 달리기 좋은 코스 8곳을 찾았어요.

## 추천 러닝 코스

| 코스 이름 | 거리 | 고저차 | 숙소에서 거리 | 특징 | 출처 |
|---------|------|--------|-------------|------|------|
| **가모가와 공원(鴨川公園)** | 8.8km | 21m | 0.57km | 교토에서 가장 인기 있는 러닝 코스. 강변 산책로가 30km 이상 이어지며, 벚꽃 명소. 강 아래 레벨과 강 위 레벨 두 가지 경로 선택 가능 | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/280727155), [GreatRuns](https://greatruns.com/location/kyoto-japan/) |
| **마루야마 공원(Maruyama Park)** | 1.48km | 39m | 0.75km | 히가시야마 산 기슭의 도심 공원. 여러 신사를 지나는 산책로, 작은 연못과 녹지. 벚꽃 시즌에 특히 인기 | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/54170783), [GreatRuns](https://greatruns.com/location/kyoto-japan/) |
| **교토 교엔(Imperial Palace)** | 1.3km × 0.7km | 확인 불가 | 약 2km | 황궁 정원. 넓은 정원과 역사적 명소를 지나는 경로. 교토 러닝의 하이라이트 중 하나 | [GreatRuns](https://greatruns.com/location/kyoto-japan/) |
| **니조성(Nijō Castle) 둘레** | 1.8km | 확인 불가 | 약 2km | 1603년 건축된 성 주변 둘레길. 황궁이나 가모가와 경로와 연결 가능 | [GreatRuns](https://greatruns.com/location/kyoto-japan/) |
| **헤이안 신궁 정원(平安神宮神苑)** | 1.38km | 3m | 1.7km | 평탄한 정원 둘레 코스 | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/429329452) |
| **오카자키 공원(Okazaki Park)** | 0.82km | 4m | 1.56km | 평탄한 공원 둘레 코스 | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/432843532) |
| **철학자의 길(Philosopher's Path)** | 5.8km | 확인 불가 (출처 설명: 완만한 오르막) | 약 2km | 난젠지 절, 에이칸도 절을 연결하는 동쪽 교토의 명소 코스. 벚꽃과 다양한 꽃나무가 아름다운 산책로 | [Kyoto Travel](https://kyoto.travel/en/travel-inspiration/five-runs/) |
| **우메코지 공원(Umekōji Park)** | 1.76km | 3m | 2.6km | 평탄한 공원 둘레 코스 | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/121131295) |

## 4월 초 날씨 (평년 기준)
- **평균 최고기온**: 19.9°C
- **평균 최저기온**: 9.7°C
- **월 평균 강수량**: 152.6mm
- **비 오는 날**: 약 11.3일
- **평균 습도**: 72%

4월 초는 교토의 벚꽃 시즌으로, 가모가와 공원과 마루야마 공원, 철학자의 길 등에서 벚꽃을 보며 달릴 수 있는 최고의 시기입니다. 아침 기온은 10°C 전후로 쌀쌀하니 가벼운 긴팔이 좋고, 낮에는 20°C 가까이 올라가 반팔로도 충분합니다.

*(날씨는 2024~2026년 4월 관측 평균 기준 추정치입니다)*

## 러닝 크루 정보
현지 러닝 크루 정보는 검색 오류로 확인하지 못했습니다. 교토 시내 러닝샵이나 숙소에서 현지 러닝 모임 정보를 문의해 보시는 것을 추천드립니다.

**가장 추천하는 코스는 가모가와 공원입니다.** 숙소에서 도보 5~7분이면 도착하고, 원하는 만큼 거리를 조절할 수 있으며, 교토 러너들이 가장 많이 찾는 명소입니다.

Formerly the Imperial capital of Japan, Kyoto is a city of 1.5 million located in the central part of the island of Honshu, Japan. It’s one of the more popular cities to visit in Japan, 
 famous for its numerous classical Buddhist temples, gardens, imperial palaces, Shinto shrines and traditional wooden houses. 
The city sits in a valley and is surrounded by mountains on three sides. There are some lovely for running in Kyoto. 
NOTE: 
It is not appropriate to within temple grounds. 
A must-do run in Kyoto is the garden-like grounds of the 
Imperial Palace
, which can be combined with the nearby Nijō Castle path. The best place for a longer run in Kyoto is to choose a section of the 30 km of paths along the 
Kamo River
. 
Maruyama Park
 is another nice spot. For some hills, head to the 
Yoshidayama Hill and Green Space
 near Kyoto University. For a memorable, challenging run, head to 
Fushimi Inari & Mt. Inari
. Also memorable are the grounds around 
Myōshin-ji Temple
.
Like many Japanese cities, Kyoto is densely populated. The central part is laid out in a grid pattern. The main business district lies just to the south of the Palace, while Kyoto’s greener sections are to the north. Kyoto has fantastic transportation system consisting of municipal buses, rail, and two subway lines: the green colored 
Karasumal line and the vermilion colored Tōzai line.

Kyoto has a humid subtropical climate, which means hot, humid summers and cool winters. Runners should prepare for the heat of summer, where average high temperatures are near 33C (92F), and nights stay very warm. Winters are relatively mild, with average January highs about 9C (48F), with temps sometimes dipping below freezing, and occasional snow. Spring is delightful, highlighted by the cherry blossoms. Kyoto gets its share of rain, with greater amounts in summer due to thunderstorms.
Kyoto has an abundance of hotels, with a large number in the central business district just south of the Imperial Palace. This is a good area to stay from a running perspective, due to proximity of the Kyoto Gyoen (grounds of the Imperial Palace) and the Kamo River paths.
Note from a member of the Great Runs community
: I would always recommend anybody visiting the city to stay near the river east of Pontocho in the Gion area or slightly north because it offers a good balance between being in everyday Kyoto, but also just on the edge of those things you want to see. It also provides easy access to the running paths on the river and most transportation lines. I have stayed in this area multiple times now and never regretted it. Everything is a walk away and if necessary, there is a subway stop even closer.

Walking is, of course, a classic way to explore the city. When browsing books on Kyoto, you often see headings like “Kyoto Walking Routes” or “Strolling Through Kyoto.” However, Kyoto is also a wonderful place to run. Here are three main reasons why:
Reason 1: Few Steep Hills
Kyoto sits in a basin surrounded by mountains on three sides, which means the central city is relatively flat. With the exception of some hilly areas in the east and north, there are very few steep slopes, making it easy and comfortable to run.
Reason 2: History, City Life, and Nature—All in One
From World Heritage temples and shrines to the natural setting of the Kamo River, and from business districts to residential neighborhoods, Kyoto brings many layers together in a compact area. Running through the city allows you to experience its history, culture, and living traditions all at once. Feeling the city’s terrain directly is part of the appeal.
Reason 3: Easy Navigation, Fewer Wrong Turns
Central Kyoto is laid out in a grid pattern—often described as a “checkerboard.” This dates back to the construction of the Heian period capital (794) using a Chinese-style grid-based planning system at the time. As long as you keep a rough sense of direction, it’s easy to avoid getting lost. Also, with relatively few high-rise buildings, landmarks are easy to spot: Mt. Daimonji to the east, Kyoto Tower to the south—helpful visual cues that make orientation simple, especially for visitors.
Kyoto is great for walking—but it’s just as enjoyable for running.
Finish an early-morning run and enjoy breakfast, or combine a run with sightseeing. The city is also home to many old-fashioned public bathhouses, perfect for easing tired muscles afterward. A sauna session is another great way to refresh and unwind.
Here, we’ve selected five short running courses (2–6 km) that are easy to enjoy even during short breaks in your travel schedule. Each course starts near a conveniently located station.

Kinukake-no-Michi Route: Run Through Three World Heritage Sites
Approx. 2.5 km / about 15 minutes
Gentle uphill
Our first recommendation starts at Omuro Ninna-ji Station on the Randen Line, heading north-northwest from Kyoto Station. The route passes three Buddhist temples that are World Heritage sites—Ninna-ji Temple, Ryōan-ji Temple, and ends near Kinkaku-ji Temple—along the scenic Kinukake-no-Michi road.
From Omuro Ninna-ji Station, enter Kinukake-no-Michi and follow the road. After a large S-curve heading northeast, you’ll see the entrance to Ryōan-ji Temple on your left. Soon, Ritsumeikan University appears on the right and the Kyoto Prefectural Insho Domoto Museum of Fine Arts on the left—signaling that Kinkaku-ji Temple is close.
The route is simple, but a gentle uphill continues throughout, so a relaxed pace is recommended. Sidewalks are narrow, and during peak tourist seasons there may be more people walking or waiting for buses, but please run with care and avoid getting off the sidewalks.
The name of the road Kinukake-no-Michi  (literally, the “cloth shrouded” road) comes from Mt. Kinugasa, a modest 201-meter hill located roughly between Ryōan-ji Temple and the Domoto Museum—see if you can spot it.
(Route summary)
Omuro Ninna-ji Station → Ninna-ji Temple→ Ryōan-ji Temple→ Kyoto Prefectural Insho-Domoto Museum → Kinkaku-ji Temple
Approx. 2.5 km (about 15 minutes at 6 min/km)
Kyoto Station Route: From Modern Architecture to Some of Japan’s Largest Temples
Subtle bends in Karasuma Street
Approx. 2.7 km / about 17 minutes
This course begins at Kyoto Station, the city’s main gateway. From the station building, run past two of the largest Buddhist temples—Higashi Hongan-ji Temple and Nishi Hongan-ji Temple—then loop back to Kyoto Station.
Although the area around Kyoto Station is filled with office buildings and large commercial facilities, you’ll soon encounter the impressive Goeido Gate of Higashi Hongan-ji Temple. The forecourt has been redeveloped into a spacious plaza with wider sidewalks and clean public restrooms. Continue west along Shinhanaya-cho Street to Horikawa Street, where Nishi Hongan-ji Temple—another World Heritage site—comes into view.
One point of interest on this route is the set of “bending streets.” While Kyoto’s roads are generally straight, both Karasuma Street near Higashi Hongan-ji Temple and Horikawa Street near Nishi Hongan-ji Temple curve slightly eastward. This dates back to Meiji-period (1868-1912) road widening projects, when streets were rerouted to avoid temple precincts for tram lines. The shift is subtle on maps but noticeable on site.
(Route summary)
Kyoto Station → Higashi Hongan-ji Temple→ Nishi Hongan-ji Temple→ Kyoto Station
Approx. 2.7 km (about 17 minutes at 6 min/km)
★ Public bathhouses nearby
Kitayama & Nakaragi-no-Michi Route: From Shrine Neighborhood to the Kamo River
The tranquil Myojin-gawa stream running through the historic shrine district
Approx. 4.5 km / about 27 minutes
Escape the city bustle in the Kitayama area. Start from Kitayama Station (Exit 1), about 15 minutes by subway from Kyoto Station. The route passes the traditional neighborhood near Kamigamo-jinja Shrine where the Shinto shrine priests have lived, follows the Kamo River, and finishes at Kitaōji Station.
The first half winds through quiet residential streets, so watch for cars on narrower roads. After passing Ota Shrine, famous for its irises, the road opens up and reveals the atmospheric shrine-priest neighborhood (Shake-machi) of Kamigamo-jinja Shrine’s clergy.
The Shake-machi area preserves the old landscape well, including the carefully maintained riverside scenery of Myojin-gawa with small bridges, gates, and benches make this an ideal rest spot. Continue past Kamigamo-jinja Shrine and run south along the Kamo River, then onto Nakaragi-no-Michi, known for its weeping cherry trees.
Note that the adjacent Kyoto Botanical Gardens, which recently marked its 100th anniversary, is part of the Kyoto Marathon course but is not open for regular jogging.
(Route summary)
Kitayama Station → Kamigamo-jinja Shrine District → Kamigamo-jinja Shrine → Kamo River → Kitaoji Station
Approx. 4.5 km (about 27 minutes at 6 min/km)

Philosopher’s Path has a wide variety of flowers and trees that make it beautiful year-round
Approx. 5.8 km / about 35 minutes

This route links some of eastern Kyoto’s most famous sites, including Nanzen-ji Temple, Eikan-dō Temple, and the Philosopher’s Path.

다낭 미케비치 근처에서 8월 아침 러닝은 **날씨 때문에 쉽지 않지만, 일출 시간대(5:00~6:30)에 뛰면 괜찮아요.**

## 8월 날씨 (평년값 기준)
- **평균 최고 기온**: 35.3°C
- **평균 최저 기온**: 27.1°C
- **평균 습도**: 69%
- **평균 강수량**: 132.3mm (월 평균 16.7일 비)

8월은 다낭에서 가장 덥고 습한 시기입니다. 아침 최저 기온도 27°C 정도로 높고, 한 달에 절반 이상 비가 내립니다. **일출 전후(5:00~6:30)에 뛰는 것이 가장 쾌적하며**, 정오는 피해야 합니다.

*(2024~2026년 8월 관측 평균, Open-Meteo Historical Weather API 기준)*

---

## 미케비치 근처 러닝 코스

| 코스 이름 | 거리 | 고저차 | 숙소에서 거리 | 특징 | 출처 |
|---------|------|--------|-------------|------|------|
| **미케비치 해변로** | 6km (왕복 12km) | 0m (평탄) | 0km (해변가) | 30km 해변 중 북쪽 6km 구간에 산책로 있음. 모래는 물가 쪽이 단단해 달리기 가능. 야자수 그늘 구간 있음. 일출 명소 | [Great Runs](https://greatruns.com/da-nang-my-khe-beach/) |
| **보응우옌잡 해안도로** | 5~10km (조절 가능) | 0m (평탄) | 0km (해변 따라) | 이스트 씨 파크에서 출발해 해변 따라 달리는 평탄한 코스. 일출 시간대 추천 | [Visit Vietnam](https://www.visitvietnam.net/blog/da-nang-running-routes/) |
| **공비엔호응인 공원** | 0.47km (둘레) | 0m | 0.43km | 작은 호수 공원 둘레길 | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/962130353) |

---

## 러닝 팁
- **시간대**: 일출 전후(5:00~6:30)가 가장 좋습니다. 해가 뜨기 전 하늘이 회색-파란색이다가 바다가 주황-분홍으로 물들며 해가 떠오르는 광경을 볼 수 있어요.
- **물 준비**: 해변과 강변에는 달리는 중 물을 구하기 어려우니 미리 챙기세요.
- **교통**: 산책로를 이용하면 안전합니다. 차도를 달릴 때는 눈에 잘 띄는 옷을 입으세요.
- **혼자가 아닙니다**: 이른 아침 해변과 강변에는 운동하는 현지인들이 많아 안전하고 활기찬 분위기입니다.

출처: [Visit Vietnam 러닝 가이드](https://www.visitvietnam.net/blog/da-nang-running-routes/)

---

## 러닝 크루
- **Da Nang Run Club** (Facebook 그룹): 주말 아침 모임이 있으며 초보자, 여행자, 외국인 모두 환영합니다.  
  출처: [Facebook](https://www.facebook.com/groups/892936959920765/)

현재 다낭 지역 러닝 크루의 구체적인 8월 일정은 확인하지 못했습니다. 위 Facebook 그룹에 문의하시면 최신 모임 정보를 얻을 수 있어요.

---

**결론**: 8월 다낭은 덥고 습하지만, **일출 시간대(5:00~6:30)에 미케비치 해변로를 달리면 시원한 바람과 아름다운 일출을 즐기며 쾌적하게 뛸 수 있습니다.** 정오는 피하고, 물을 꼭 챙기세요!

{"url": "https://www.visitvietnam.net/blog/da-nang-running-routes/", "content": "Da Nang Running Routes: Best 5 - 10km Runs for Visitors

Run the City Awake: Da Nang's Best 5 - 10 km Routes for Runners
07/06/2026
Three scenic 5–10K running routes in Da Nang, from the Han River and My Khe Beach to Son Tra Peninsula, best enjoyed before the city fully wakes up.
The best way to get to know Da Nang is to run through it before the sun gets too high
Some cities are best introduced through a taxi window. Da Nang, though, makes more sense in running shoes, especially before six in the morning, when the air is still cool, the riverside and beachfront belong to early risers, and the sea is just beginning to turn pink.
This city feels made for running. The riverfront is long and flat. The coastal road is wide, open, and breezy. The bridges sit close enough together to turn into easy loops. And when you want something that asks a little more from your legs, Son Tra Peninsula is right there, green, steep, and just difficult enough to keep you humble.
Here are three routes that are scenic without being complicated, all within a runner-friendly 5-10km range. You can take them slow and use them to see the city, or hold a steadier pace if you are training for a race. Lace up; the best one is saved for last, and it comes with a sunrise.
The riverside loop: Han River promenade and city bridges
If you want an easy first run in Da Nang, start by the Han River. This is a gentle city route in the best way: flat paths, wide pavements, morning walkers, local runners, and the river quietly reflecting the bridges beside you.
On the west bank, the stretch around Bach Dang Street toward Thuan Phuoc Bridge is an easy place to begin. You can run out and back for a neat 5K. If you want something more interesting, turn it into a loop: cross one bridge, run along the opposite bank, then return by another. Han River Bridge, Dragon Bridge, Tran Thi Ly Bridge, and Thuan Phuoc Bridge can all become part of the route, depending on how far you want to go.
Morning is the most comfortable time, before the sun gets too strong and the city is still warming up slowly. Evening has its own charm too, with bridge lights on the water, cooler air, and a livelier atmosphere. Just keep in mind that the Dragon Bridge area gets crowded on weekends, especially around the fire and water show. It is beautiful, but not ideal if you care about pace.
Anchor points: Dragon Bridge, Bach Dang Street, the Han River banks, or East Sea Park if you want to connect to the beachfront.
Distance: 5K out and back; 7–10K if you loop across the bridges.
Best time: 5:00–6:30 AM or after sunset.
The hill climb: Son Tra Peninsula
When you want to trade flat pavement for a little punishment, head toward Son Tra. From the base of the peninsula on Hoang Sa Street, the road starts climbing into the green. Long inclines, hairpin bends, and sudden sea views around the corners make this route beautiful, but it also deserves respect.
This is not the route for a casual midday jog. Son Tra is better for runners who already have some mileage in their legs, especially those training for hills, endurance, a half marathon, a full marathon, or a trail race. You can adjust the difficulty as you go. Running up to Linh Ung Pagoda and turning back is already a solid morning effort. If your legs are good, the weather is kind, and the road conditions allow, you can push farther toward Ban Co Peak.
The memorable part of Son Tra is not only the climb. It is the way the city disappears behind you so quickly, replaced by forest, wind, and flashes of blue sea through the trees. If you are lucky, you may even spot a red-shanked douc high in the canopy. Running here feels less like moving through a city and more like stepping into a very different side of Da Nang.
Start early, ideally around first light. Bring your own water, because there are almost no convenient places to refill along the route. Wear something visible if you begin before sunrise, and stay alert, as parts of the road are narrow and shared with motorbikes and cars.
Anchor points: Hoang Sa Street → Linh Ung Pagoda → optional extension toward Ban Co Peak.
Distance: Flexible depending on your turnaround point; hilly and better for stronger runners.
Best time: Sunrise; avoid midday.
🛵
Curious about Son Tra without running it? Try exploring the peninsula by motorbike instead, when you can slow down, stop longer, and save your legs for the views.
The sunrise route: My Khe Beach
This is the route worth setting an early alarm for. The coastal road, Vo Nguyen Giap connecting into Hoang Sa, follows the long golden stretch of My Khe Beach and gives you one of the easiest, breeziest runs in Da Nang: flat, open, wide, sea-cooled, and full of that quiet feeling of a city waking up beside you.
Start around East Sea Park and follow the beachfront path. For a 5K, pick a point about 2.5 km away and turn back. For a 10K, keep your rhythm a little longer toward Son Tra or down toward Truong Sa. This is the kind of route where the kilometers can pass almost without you noticing, because there is always something to look at: locals exercising, rows of palms, the sea, small boats in the distance, and then the sun slowly lifting out of the water.
The best window is around 5:00–6:30 AM. A little before sunrise, the sky is still blue-grey and quiet. Then the sea begins to shift into orange and pink before the day fully brightens. You may not run your fastest here, because at some point you will probably want to slow down and look. That is also the reason this route is so worth doing.
Quietly, this may be one of the most beautiful urban running routes in Vietnam. It is also one of the simplest ways to fall for Da Nang.
Anchor points: East Sea Park, Vo Nguyen Giap Street, Hoang Sa Street, My Khe Beach.
Distance: 5–10K, flat and suitable for many levels.
Best time: 5:00–6:30 AM for sunrise.
Running tips in Da Nang
Avoid the heat. Da Nang is warm and humid for much of the year, so sunrise and after sunset are the most comfortable windows. Midday is better saved for coffee or a proper meal, not for forcing out a few kilometers under the sun.
Carry water. Along the beach and river, you can usually find cafés or shops after your run, but not every stretch has easy water access while you are moving. On Son Tra, you should be even more prepared.
You will not be running alone. Early mornings in Da Nang are full of people walking, jogging, stretching, and exercising by the river and beach. That friendly local rhythm makes solo running feel easier and safer.
Watch the traffic. Use promenades and walking paths whenever possible. On Son Tra, the roads are narrower and shared with motorbikes and cars, so stay to the side, wear visible clothing, and keep your attention on the road.
If you are new to running, start flat. The Han River and My Khe Beach routes are smooth, wide, and forgiving. Save Son Tra for a day when you actually want to climb.
If you are chasing a race, Da Nang hosts international marathon events during the year. Check the current race calendar if you want to plan your trip around one.
And finally, reward yourself. Finishing a run near the river or the sea means you are only a few steps from good coffee, mi Quang, banh mi, or a proper Vietnamese breakfast. In Da Nang, the post-run meal is very much part of the route.

 Running in the GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON
Race entries will be allocated by lottery. This ensures that everyone has an equal chance of securing a starting spot.

check out the other disciplines and events
 as well.
Registration period for the lottery:
 October 1, 2026 to November 12, 2026
Announcement of lottery results:

Ways to register

step-by-step guide to registration
.
Participation information
Participation fee
215 €
The payment will be charged after the drawing and only if you have been assigned a race entry.
The entry fee includes:
A 4-day public transportation pass for fare zones A, B, and C
Pacemakers in all starting waves
A personalized finisher’s certificate available for download
A high-quality poncho at the finish line (alternatively: clothing bag service for 5 €)
Massage services along the courses and in the finish area
Eligibility
All runners born in 2009 or earlier are eligible to participate.
Nordic walkers are not permitted.
Walkers are permitted as long as they finish within the time limit.
The GENERALI BERLIN-MARATHON is organized in accordance with the regulations of the German Athletics Association (DLV) and World Athletics (WA), under the supervision of the Berlin Athletics Association (BLV).
The time limit is 6:15 hours.
                Ad

You can enter the lottery in
 one of the following three ways
. The selection you make when you enter is final and cannot be changed later.
Individual runner
Sign up for the lottery via your 
personal user account
.
Please review your registration carefully, as 
no changes can be made once you've completed it
.
After the drawing, you'll automatically receive an email with your drawing results.
A team of 2 to 3 people
Each team member needs 
their own user account
.
When registering, 
the first person
 indicates that this is a team registration. They choose a team name.
Once registration is complete, this person will receive a 
team code
 in the registration confirmation.
They pass this code on to the other team members.
When registering, the other members select the option “Join an existing team” and enter the code.

: This code cannot be added after registration is complete.
Each team member then registers independently, enters payment information, and receives a confirmation via email.
Participation
If the team is selected in the drawing, every member of the team receives a starting spot.
There is no team ranking. Each person runs individually and is listed individually in the results.

Fast runner with a qualifying time
To register as a fast runner, you must upload proof of your qualifying time and age via 
your user account
 during the registration process.
Registering as a fast runner does not guarantee a spot in the race. You will receive notification of acceptance or rejection after your documentation has been reviewed, as soon as the results of the lottery are announced.
Make sure that all qualification information is clearly visible on your proof of qualification.
 If your proof is invalid, your registration will be included in the general lottery.
Proof
Only official certificates and links to a race’s official results page will be accepted as proof.
Only marathon times will be considered. These must not be older than 2 years. (Proof from 2025, 2026)
Results from other disciplines or virtual events will not be considered.
Qualifying Times
The qualifying time must have been achieved in an official race that is part of the AbbottWMM Wanda Age Group World Rankings, certified by AIMS, or listed by USATF.

.

December 3, 2026
.
If you’ve been selected for a starting spot, our service provider, Adyen N.V., will process the payment for the entry fee starting on December 4, 2026. Depending on your bank, this process may take up to one week.
If you did not receive a spot, you can check out the other ways to participate.
Guaranteed race entries
Guaranteed race entries
Voucher for the Next Year
If you were unable to participate in the BERLIN-MARATHON and took advantage of our goodwill offer, we will automatically send you a registration code for 2027 via email. This code can be redeemed until 11:59 p.m. (CET) on November 12, 2026.
Jubilee-Club

Jubilee Club
 can secure a guaranteed spot.
Sozialticket

Please email 
sozialticket@scc-events.com
 and attach a copy of your ID and your Sozialticket S. We will then send you an access code.
Things to Know About the Race
Clothing drop-off or Poncho
When you register, you can choose between a poncho and a clothing bag.
If you choose a clothing bag, an additional fee of €5 will be charged.
Important
: You can only book the clothing bag during registration. It is not possible to book it later.
Poncho

You may only bring clothing and valuables onto the event grounds in this clothing bag
Items must be placed loosely inside the bag; this means do not pack a backpack or gym bag inside the bag

Race material

비크 마을 주변의 러닝 코스와 현지 러닝 크루 정보를 찾았어요.

## 🏃 비크 주변 러닝 코스

비크는 인구 300명 정도의 작은 마을이라 전용 러닝 코스보다는 자연 경관을 따라 달리는 트레일이 주를 이룹니다.

| 코스명 | 거리 | 고저차 | 숙소에서 거리 | 특징 | 출처 |
|--------|------|--------|--------------|------|------|
| **Hatta 트레일** | 2.89km (편도) | 427m | 0.53km | 산책로·강변길. 상당한 고저차가 있는 트레일 | [OpenStreetMap](https://www.openstreetmap.org/way/443466965) |
| **비크 마을 - 레이니스피아라 해변 왕복** | 약 10km | 34m | 마을 중심 출발 | 비크 교회(Víkurkirkja)에서 출발해 유명한 검은 모래 해변까지. 평탄한 편이지만 해변 자체는 위험한 파도 때문에 직접 달리기 부적합. 고지대 트레일 이용 권장 | [Great Runs](https://greatruns.com/location/iceland-highlights/), [AllTrails](https://www.alltrails.com/trail/iceland/southern/viewpoint-of-reynisfjara-and-dyrholaey) |
| **디르홀레이(Dyrhólaey) 전망대 코스** | 약 8-10km | 확인 불가 | 비크에서 약 5km | 절벽 위 전망대까지 오르는 코스. 퍼핀 서식지로 유명 (5월 1일~6월 25일 폐쇄). 검은 모래 해변과 남부 해안 파노라마 뷰 | [South.is](https://www.south.is/en/travel-info/newsblog/black-sand-and-basalt-columns-discovering-reynisfjara-and-dyrholaey) |
| **Mýrdalshlaupið 대회 코스** | 21km / 10km / 3km | 1,100m (21km) / 490m (10km) | 비크 마을 출발 | 매년 5월 말 열리는 트레일 러닝 대회 코스. 화산 지형과 빙하 전망. 매우 도전적인 산악 코스 | [Mýrdalshlaupið 공식](https://myrdalshlaup.is/) |

### ⚠️ 안전 주의사항
- **레이니스피아라 검은 모래 해변**: 물가에서 직접 달리는 것은 매우 위험합니다. 예측 불가능한 "스니커 웨이브(sneaker waves)"와 강한 이안류 때문에 해변 직접 러닝은 피하고, 고지대 트레일을 이용하세요.
- 아이슬란드 날씨는 변덕스러우니 방풍·방수 장비 필수입니다.

## 👥 현지 러닝 크루 모임

비크는 매우 작은 마을이라 자체 러닝 크루는 확인되지 않았습니다. 가장 가까운 러닝 커뮤니티는 레이캬비크(비크에서 약 186km)에 있습니다:

### 레이캬비크 러닝 크루
- **Mikkeller Running Club Reykjavík**
  - 모임: 매주 화요일 18:00
  - 장소: Mikkeller Bar, Östgötagatan
  - 거리: 약 6km
  - 페이스: 5:30 min/km
  - 언어: 영어 & 아이슬란드어
  - 출처: [NordRun Clubs](https://nordrunclubs.com/clubs/mikkeller-running-club-reykjavikreykjavikiceland)

### 가이드 투어 옵션
- **Run Wild Iceland** (Siggi Júlíusson 가이드)
  - 6일 트레일 러닝 투어 (5월~9월)
  - 남부 해안 포함, 비크 지역 Mýrdalur 코스 포함
  - 소규모 그룹 (4-12명)
  - 출처: [Run Wild Iceland](https://runwild.is/)

- **Arctic Running Tours**
  - 아이슬란드 트레일 가이드 투어 제공
  - 출처: [Arctic Running](https://www.arcticrunning.is/)

비크에서는 개별 러닝이 주를 이루며, 연례 Mýrdalshlaupið 대회(다음 대회: 2027년 5월 29일)가 지역 러너들이 모이는 주요 이벤트입니다.

Frequently Asked Questions
Is it safe to jog on the black sand beaches in Vik?
While the black sand beaches like Reynisfjara are incredibly scenic, jogging directly along the waterline is 
extremely hazardous
 due to unpredictable “sneaker waves” and strong rip currents. It's crucial to stay well back from the water and never turn your back to the ocean. For a safer running experience with stunning views, consider elevated trails such as those near Reynisfjall and Dyrhólaey.
What kind of terrain can I expect on running trails around Vik?
The running trails around Vik offer a diverse landscape shaped by volcanic activity. You'll find coastal paths, dramatic clifftops, and routes with views towards glaciers like Mýrdalsjökull. The terrain can range from gentle gradients on moderate loops to challenging ascents with significant elevation gain on more difficult routes.
Are there any circular running routes available near Vik?
Yes, there are several circular running routes. For example, the 
Hestanesviki loop from Gudvangen
 is a moderate 8.4 km path with gentle gradients, perfect for a scenic run. Another option is the 
Historic Villas on Villa Road – Balestrand loop from Sygna videregående skole
, a 6.0 km trail through varied terrain.
What are some scenic viewpoints or landmarks I can see while jogging in Vik?
Vik offers breathtaking scenery. You can enjoy panoramic views of the black sand beaches, the southern coastline, and the Mýrdalsjökull Glacier from areas like Dyrhólaey. The 
Klukshaug
 viewpoint is also a great spot. The iconic Víkurkirkja church, perched on a hill, provides a picturesque landmark overlooking the village and the black sand beach.

You don’t need to be elite. You need to love the trail.

DAY 1 · ARRIVE
Reykjavík
Siggi meets you at Keflavík airport and drives you to your hotel in Reykjavík. Evening safety briefing with the group.

Hengill
Steam valleys and volcanic ridges on one of Iceland’s classic trail routes, then a soak at Reykjaböð, the new geothermal lagoon at the foot of Reykjadalur valley.

 a mountain run through the colourful geothermal highlands.

 if weather closes the highlands, you run the green coastal mountains and cliffs above Vík instead, about 2½ hours from Reykjavík.

- **접수 마감 임박**: Gatorade BKK Run은 오늘(11월 11일) 기준 9일 후 마감, Thonburi Run은 24일 후 마감입니다.
- 항공권과 숙소 가격은 **목업(실제 가격 아님)**이며, 조회 시점 기준 추정치입니다. 실제 예약 시 가격이 다를 수 있습니다.
